text:
## Issue-Specific Escalation Paths  
### Customer Complaints  
**Severity: Low (Minor service issue)**
- Initial Handler: Customer Service Staff
- Level: 1–2
- Timeline: 24 hours
- If unresolved: Escalate to Complaints Manager (Level 3)  
**Severity: High (Significant financial loss)**
- Initial Handler: Complaints Manager
- Level: 3–4
- Timeline: 24–48 hours
- Regulatory implication: Notify Compliance
- If >£100k: Board notification  
**Severity: Critical (Regulatory/reputational breach)**
- Initial Handler: Head of Customer Service + Compliance Head
- Level: 4–5
- Timeline: 24 hours
- FCA notification: Within 24 hours (if required)
- Board: Immediate notification

raw_entities.name: Customer Complaints Escalation Process
raw_entities.description: A structured escalation workflow for handling customer complaints based on severity levels (Low, High, Critical), defining handlers, timelines, and regulatory notification requirements.

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Staff
raw_entities.description: The initial handler responsible for managing low-severity customer complaints within a 24-hour timeline.

raw_entities.name: Complaints Manager
raw_entities.description: An actor who serves as the escalation point for unresolved low-severity issues and the initial handler for high-severity complaints.

raw_entities.name: Head of Customer Service
raw_entities.description: A senior leader who acts as an initial handler for critical complaints involving regulatory or reputational breaches.
context: Initial Handler: Head of Customer Service + Compliance Head

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: A senior officer who manages critical complaints and ensures regulatory notifications are handled.
context: Initial Handler: Head of Customer Service + Compliance Head

raw_entities.name: Compliance Team
raw_entities.description: The body notified when a high-severity complaint has regulatory implications.

raw_entities.name: Bank Board
raw_entities.description: The highest level of internal authority, notified of high-severity complaints exceeding £100k or critical breaches.

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
raw_entities.description: The external regulator that must be notified within 24 hours in the event of a critical regulatory or reputational breach.

raw_entities.name: Level 1–2 — Frontline Resolution
raw_entities.description: The initial tier of complaint handling managed by Customer Service Staff with a 24-hour resolution timeline.

raw_entities.name: Level 3 — Complaints Manager Resolution
raw_entities.description: The escalation tier for unresolved low-severity issues and the starting tier for high-severity issues.

raw_entities.name: Level 4 — Management Resolution
raw_entities.description: A high-level resolution tier involved in significant financial losses and critical breaches.

raw_entities.name: Level 5 — Executive/Board Resolution
raw_entities.description: The highest escalation tier for critical regulatory or reputational breaches involving the Board and Compliance Head.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Severity Assessment
raw_entities.description: The initial branching point where a complaint is categorized as Low, High, or Critical, determining the handler, timeline, and escalation path.

raw_entities.name: Low Severity Resolution Check
raw_entities.description: A decision point for low-severity complaints; if unresolved within 24 hours, the issue is escalated to Level 3.
context: If unresolved: Escalate to Complaints Manager (Level 3)

raw_entities.name: Financial Loss Threshold Check
raw_entities.description: A gate for high-severity complaints; if the financial loss exceeds £100k, the Board must be notified.
